system.description:
You can build things. You must choose a focus — Carpentry, Clockworks, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, Painting, Mechanics, Electronics and the like — each counting as a separate Ability. Crafts covers works of art as well as technical labor.

Making or repairing an item usually involves a Physical Challenge of dexterity, with difficulty set by the job. Works made with Crafts x3 or better may entrance Toreador. The Tzimisce practice a Body Crafts focus when using Vicissitude, covering flaying, tattooing and other alterations of the flesh.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
